## Feature Selection with Lasso

Lasso performs regression with an L1 penalty, shrinking some coefficients exactly to zero. This example keeps only the predictors with non-zero coefficients at the selected regularization level.

```{r}
source(url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cefet-rj-dal/daltoolbox/main/examples/seed.R"))
# installation
# install.packages("daltoolbox")

library(daltoolbox)
```

```{r}
data(Diabetes)
head(Diabetes)
```

```{r}
fs <- feature_selection_lasso("target")
set_example_seed()
fs <- fit(fs, Diabetes)

print(fs$selected)
print(fs$ranking)

diabetes_fs <- transform(fs, Diabetes)
head(diabetes_fs)
```

References
- Tibshirani, R. (1996). Regression Shrinkage and Selection via the Lasso.
